title: Cross-peer failure-domain and artifact-acceptance crosswalk
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local source/test crosswalk; plan-only
scope: Refresh peer status and technical details for incomplete DXF output, malformed text framing, missing block bodies, and omitted ACIS payloads.
Separate peer issue statements, proposed unmerged patches, local generated control coverage, and normative format evidence.
Refine existing route-acceptance sequencing without creating routine peer-build, full-suite, fixture, or support gates.

sources.observed: #1355 reports exit-success with a truncated DXF. The still-open #1360 PR corrects its author's earlier root-cause hypothesis: an invalid modular-character read in handle-map processing was accepted as data; its narrow resynchronization proposal restores the reported sample, while the author says silent-success reporting remains unfixed. #1408 is a complex CR-bearing TEXT/MTEXT report whose simple bare-CR reproducer reportedly passes. #1409 reports skipped block bodies from a helper advancing its caller's object-array index and includes a proposed patch. #1411 reports retained modeler entity shells with missing AcDs/SAB payload in a named 0.14.8593 route. These are peer-specific, unmerged/unreproduced evidence, not libdxfrw findings.

Issue #1195 reports that ACadSharp 3.4.9 reads DWG 3DSOLID/REGION entities but its DXF writer omits them, including solids inside otherwise-present blocks. PR #1240 is still open in the reviewed page. No customer drawing was downloaded or run.

localEvidence: tests/wave1_tests.cpp::testDxfWriterControlCharacterFraming checks transactional ASCII CR/LF refusal and rollback, plus Binary value framing and a following-record sentinel.
tests/block_owner_tests.cpp and the PAR-49 generated ownership controls check block-body/owner identity and closure; this pass did not rerun them.
tests/modeler_dxf_writer_matrix_tests.cpp contains generated modeler-carrier writer controls; those controls do not establish arbitrary ACIS B-rep semantics.
src/intern/dwg_dxf_output_transaction.cpp, tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py, and tools/run_independent_dxf.py provide existing output-publication and independent-DXF validation routes.
Existing plan sections already assign source/output identity and modeler-payload evidence to PAR-06, PAR-07/S8, PAR-14, PAR-20, and PAR-49.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-06 output completion and per-source disposition
PAR-07/S8 composed route acceptance and modeler evidence separation
PAR-14 parser error provenance and bounded recovery evidence

planChanges: Record that LibreDWG PR #1360 is open and that its author corrected the initial #1355 root-cause diagnosis; do not treat the proposal as merged or transfer its heuristic.
Keep decode status, output publication/completion, strict DXF syntax, owner-level identity, and ACIS payload/semantic evidence as distinct acceptance stages.
Reuse the existing generated CR/LF, block-owner, modeler-carrier, transaction, and strict-DXF controls; run composed validation only at the existing route/family checkpoint.
Keep issue reports as failure-shape leads and preserve the six J items as DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
limitations: Peer behaviors were reviewed from issue/PR pages only; peer builds and executables were not run.
PR #1360 and the ACadSharp PR #1240 are proposals, not merged/released behavior in this evidence snapshot.
No peer/customer drawings were downloaded, including the confidential sample mentioned by LibreDWG #1411.
Local source/test mapping was read-only and no test command was run.
